The total percentage of students who qualified in the year 2016 (correct up to two decimals) is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of students who appeared in 2016 = 55 + 35 + 48 + 50 + 55 + 60 = 303 thousand

Total number of students who qualified in 2016 = 42 + 22 + 26 + 30 + 27 + 19 = 166 thousand

Total percentage of students who qualified = (166 / 303) × 100 ≈ 54.78%

**∴ The total percentage of students who qualified in the year 2016 is approximately 54.78%.**
